title: Triple Pink-Haired Warrior
description: Three identical poses of a young female character with pink hair in pigtails, wearing a dark armored dress with green accents, a crown, and a cape. One pose shows her jumping forward with one leg raised and hand extended, while the other two show running and crouched stances, all against a solid bright green background with a green splash effect at the bottom.
prompt: A cartoon character sheet showing three dynamic action poses of the same young girl with bright pink pigtails, a small crown, and a determined expression while chewing bubblegum. She wears a black and green armored dress with bubble-like patterns, green shoulder pads, black gloves and boots, and a light green cape.
